params.description: ID of the session that contains the clip.

params.name: clipUuid
params.description: ID of the clip you want to download.

items.docs:
Returns the details of a clip and a link to download it.

If the clip is still being prepared, the response returns a status of `GENERATING` and no link. Call this endpoint again every few seconds until the status becomes `GENERATED`, then use the `clipUrl` to download the clip. The link is valid for 15 minutes; after it expires, call the endpoint again to get a new one.

  - Sessions must be found within tests with the "STUDYV2" type and belong to one of the following product

info.name: Find all clips for a session video

params.name: sessionId
params.description: ID of the session whose video clips you want to retrieve.

items.docs:
Returns the clips created from a session video, including clip timing, media flags, layout, and video region metadata.

  _Compatibility:_
  - Sessions must be found within tests with the "STUDYV2" type and belong to one of the following product types that support session video clips:
    - "LIVE_CONVERSATION" (non-classic live conversation)
    - "NON_THINK_OUT_LOUD" (interaction test)
    - "THINK_OUT_LOUD" (think-out-loud test).
  - Go to [How to Obtain a Test ID (UUID)](https://developer.use

info.name: Find all highlight reels for a test

params.name: testId
params.description: ID of the test whose highlight reels you want to retrieve.

items.docs:
Returns all highlight reels for the test. Each highlight reel includes its ID, name, duration, last updated timestamp, clip count, and whether all test clips are included in the reel.

  _Compatibility:_
  - Tests must be of the "STUDYV2" type and belong to one of the following product types:
    - "LIVE_CONVERSATION" (non-classic live conversation)
    - "NON_THINK_OUT_LOUD" (interaction test)
    - "THINK_OUT_LOUD" (think-out-loud test).
  - Go to [How to Obtain a Test ID (UUID)](https://devel
